en.headline: Hong Kong youth squash team to make world championships debut
en.dek: Nineteen players will leave for New York next week after a send-off attended by Financial Secretary Paul Chan, the first time the city fields a youth squash side at the worlds.
body: Hong Kong will send its first youth squash team to a world championships next week, after a send-off ceremony on Saturday attended by Financial Secretary Paul Chan. About 30 young players are in the squad assembled by the Hong Kong Squash association and the YOU AND ME Foundation; 19 of them will fly to New York to compete against more than 300 players from other places.

Chan called the trip a milestone in the city's sports development and said the government would keep investing in sport along five directions: popularisation, elite training, major events, professionalisation and industrialisation. He said the administration also attaches importance to emerging community sports such as squash and will continue to put resources into schools and districts.

The financial secretary told the players that whoever stands on that stage is already a winner, and that results matter less than showing young people from different backgrounds can go far when a door is opened. He offered three lines of advice: give everything and leave no regrets; be humble in victory and resilient in defeat; set off happily and come home safely.
Chan also thanked the YOU AND ME Foundation, which he said had since 2022 worked to turn the idea of a representative youth side into a team that will now compete under the Hong Kong banner.

zh.headline: 港青年牆球隊下周首征紐約世錦賽
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波昨日出席誓師大會，約三十名隊員之中十九人將啟程出賽，是香港首次派出青年牆球代表隊出戰世錦賽。
body: 香港歷史上第一支青年牆球代表隊將於下周前往紐約出戰世界錦標賽。財政司司長陳茂波昨日出席誓師大會。中國（香港）牆球總會及YOU AND ME基金會組成的隊伍約有三十名年青球員，其中十九人將啟程，與來自各地逾三百名選手同場競技。
陳茂波形容此行是香港體育發展路上的一個里程碑，並重申政府會繼續按普及化、精英化、盛事化、專業化及產業化五大方向投資體育。他表示政府同樣重視牆球等新興社區運動，會持續投放資源，推動運動走進校園與社區。
陳茂波對隊員說，能夠站在那裡已經是贏家，比賽成績固然重要，但更重要的是證明香港年青人無論背景如何，只要有人打開一道門，都有勇氣和能力走出去。他送給運動員三句話：全力以赴、不留遺憾；勝不驕、敗不餒；開心出發、平安回家。
陳茂波並感謝YOU AND ME基金會自二零二二年成立以來，以推動青年教育為使命，把構想逐步變成一支代表香港出賽的隊伍。
